stem: An object is placed $30$ cm in front of a convex lens of focal length $15$ cm. The image distance from the lens is

verdicts.working: Using 1/f = 1/v − 1/u with f = 15 cm and u = −30 cm gives v = 30 cm.

working:
$\dfrac{1}{f}=\dfrac{1}{v}-\dfrac{1}{u}$, with $f=15$ cm and $u=-30$ cm
$\dfrac{1}{v}=\dfrac{1}{15}-\dfrac{1}{30}=\dfrac{1}{30}$
$v=30$ cm

Independent check: Using 1/f = 1/v − 1/u with f = 15 cm and u = −30 cm gives v = 30 cm.
solution:
Using the lens formula, $\dfrac{1}{f}=\dfrac{1}{v}-\dfrac{1}{u}$, with $f=15$ cm and $u=-30$ cm:
$$\frac{1}{v}=\frac{1}{15}-\frac{1}{30}=\frac{1}{30}$$
Hence, $v=30$ cm.
